split: Stratified 80:20 outer train/test; training partition split 70:30 into model-fit and adaptation/calibration subsets

strategies.No update: Original model trained on fit subset; no adaptation.
strategies.Probability recalibration: Original model fixed; logistic recalibration fitted on separate labelled adaptation subset transformed with same shift; evaluated on separate shifted test set.
strategies.Full model retraining: Same model family refitted on the full training partition transformed/resampled to the scenario distribution; evaluated on a separate shifted test set.

calibration_metrics: Calibration intercept and slope from logistic regression of outcome on logit(predicted P(benign)); ideal intercept=0 and slope=1.
caveats: Synthetic shifts do not represent real clinical/hospital/time shifts.
The prevalence scenario uses balanced resampling of available labelled samples, not a prospective prevalence-shift cohort.
Adaptation labels are assumed available; this is a supervised updating experiment.
Small test sample means calibration slope/intercept may be unstable.
No external validation or confidence intervals are included.
